title: Lyapunov geometric-mean bound on the per-level house ratios r_j escapes the refuted strict descent
evidence: Probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/C098_lyapunov_tower.py, exact field arithmetic (Miller-Rabin primality + primitive-root subgroup mu_{2^j}; eta constant on mu_n-cosets so the worst-b house is an EXACT max over coset reps), PRIZE REGIME ONLY: n=2^mu proper dyadic subgroup, q prime ~ n^beta (beta in {4,5}), n<<sqrt q, m=(q-1)/n in {2.1e6, 1.7e7}. Three towers MU=7 (q=268437889, beta=4), MU=8 (q=4294968833, beta=4), MU=6 (q=1073741953, beta=5), B_j^2 = max_{b!=0}|eta(mu_{2^j},b)|^2 computed up the full tower j=1..MU. (1) DESCRIPTIVE half CONFIRMED: per-level r_j^2=B_j^2/B_{j-1}^2 SPIKES ABOVE 2 (r_2^2=4.00, r_3^2~3.98, r_4^2~3.65, decaying to ~2.1-2.4 deep), so the strict descent r_j<=sqrt2 for ALL j is indeed REFUTED (consistent with DISPROOF_LOG / C072 dyadic-tower verdict), while the running geometric mean G_j=(B_j^2/B_1^2)^{1/(j-1)} DOES decrease monotonically toward 2 from above (MU=7: 4.00->2.99; MU=8: 4.00->2.78; MU=6: 4.00->3.20). So C098's reframing is numerically real: spikes are absorbed, the mean trends to 2. (2) DECISIVE refutation of the ESCAPE claim: since B_1=B(mu_2)=2 is a fixed O(1) constant, G_mu=(B_mu^2/B_1^2)^{1/(mu-1)} is a STRICTLY MONOTONE function of B_mu^2 alone -- the per-level B_2..B_{mu-1} TELESCOPE OUT. Hence the Lyapunov target (1/mu)sum_j log r_j^2 -> log2 (running geom mean -> 2 from above) is monotone-EQUIVALENT to B_mu^2 = 2^mu * 2^{o(mu)} = n^{1+o(1)}, i.e. to B_mu = sqrt(n)*n^{o(1)} -- which is the BGK square-root-cancellation bound at the TOP level itself. Verified numerically (second probe block): under the BGK-floor model B_mu^2=n*log m the geom mean -> 2 only via the slack factor (log m)^{1/(mu-1)} -> 1 (mu=30:1.167, mu=64:1.074, mu=128:1.036); the geom mean has NO term that distinguishes BGK from non-BGK except through B_mu^2 which it is a monotone function of. The measured C0^2=B_mu^2/n (22.5, 20.0, 21.0) tracks the BGK floor log m (14.6, 16.6, 16.6) within an O(1) constant in-regime -- consistent with the BGK answer but NOT a proof of it. Confirms the in-tree CumulantTowerAzumaWall.lean finding from the Lyapunov angle: a geometric-mean/large-deviation bound over the per-level increments is exactly the concentration the worst coset does not have (increments add coherently, all-same-sign at b*).
wall: W-BGK: 'limsup of the running geometric mean of r_j^2 <= 2' is monotone-equivalent to B(mu_n) <= sqrt(n)*n^{o(1)} = the open BGK/Paley square-root-cancellation bound at the top level. The Lyapunov reframing re-distributes the single total budget log(B_mu^2/B_1^2) across the mu levels and tolerates exactly the (log m)^{1/mu}->1 polylog slack the prize bound already contains, but supplies NO independent control of B_mu. The (refuted) for-all-j r_j<=sqrt2 and the (live) limsup-geom-mean<=sqrt2 are genuinely logically distinct -- the latter is strictly weaker as a STATEMENT -- but the weaker statement is itself precisely the open core, not a more tractable target: there is no new inequality shape, only the same wall restated.
honest_note: OPEN, not a closure and not a refutation of any in-tree theorem. C098's logical observation is CORRECT -- DISPROOF_LOG kills only the per-level strict descent, and the geometric mean can absorb individual spikes (probe confirms both). What C098 over-claims is that this is an ESCAPE / a 'distinct untried inequality shape' with a handle: the probe's telescoping identity G_mu=(B_mu^2/B_1^2)^{1/(mu-1)} shows the geometric mean is a monotone function of the TOP house alone, so proving 'running geom mean -> sqrt2' IS proving BGK -- the per-level ratios are red herrings for the question of whether the target holds. This is the same conclusion the in-tree CumulantTowerAzumaWall.lean reaches for Azuma (the OTHER per-level/large-deviation route): both Azuma (sum-of-Linfty) and Lyapunov (geom-mean-of-ratios) are large-deviation statements over the tower increments, and both fail for the identical reason -- the worst coset's increments are coherent, not cancelling, so no per-level concentration mechanism (additive Azuma OR multiplicative Lyapunov) sees the cancellation BGK requires. Cited Lean files DyadicHalvingRecursion.lean / CumulantTowerAzumaWall.lean are genuine and axiom-clean; C098 reads them correctly but its escape conclusion does not follow. Probe is exact (no sampling): integer field arithmetic, full mu_n-coset transversal scan for the worst b, strictly prize regime (proper subgroup, large prime, large m, n<sqrt q) -- no full-group / small-prime false positive. Recommend logging as an OPEN-weld in DISPROOF_LOG alongside the Azuma wall and the C072 parallelogram verdict: 'the Lyapunov/geometric-mean tower descent is monotone-equivalent to BGK at the top -- per-level spikes telescope out, no escape.'
